newsitem.title: USA: Medi-Ject enters into option agreement.
newsitem.headline: Medi-Ject enters into option agreement.

text.p: Medi-Ject Corp said it signed an agreement to provide the Netherlands-based N.V. Organon divison of Akzo Nobel NV with an option to the Medi-Ject needle-free drug delivery technology for the administration of certain female reproductive health drugs.

During the option period, Medi-Ject will provide Organon with self-injectors and disposable needle-free syringes. Organon will evaluate drug performance and patient acceptance in short-term clinical studies.
Specific terms of the agreement and the identity of the drugs to be tested were not disclosed.
